args.jql: project = PAY AND text ~ "promo" ORDER BY updated DESC

args.body:
Investigated production Sentry CHECKOUT-WEB-7Q: PromoNotFound for ' autumn24 '; Android keyboard adds spaces and lower-case. Implemented the product + mobile agreed fix from this ticket locally in checkout/promo.py: normalize_code now returns code.strip().replace(" ", "").upper(), stripping surrounding whitespace, removing internal spaces, and uppercasing before lookup.

Added tests/test_promo.py with 8 input cases covering the production example, internal spaces, surrounding tabs/newlines, lowercase/already-normalized codes, empty/space-only input, and preservation of punctuation; also checks idempotence. Verification: python -m unittest discover -s tests -v — PASS (1 test method, 8 subcases).

Changes are local only, not deployed or submitted as a PR: the provided workspace is not a Git repository. Production resolution has not been verified.
